subject: Mine
text: The suggested level for the Mine is 19.

subject: Mine
text: To obtain the Charm Claw in the Mine, go towards the center and bomb the blocked room.

evidence.quote:
The main thing to get in here is the Charm Claw. To
get it, go towards the center and bomb the blocked room.

subject: Jinn
text: Jinn has 6,000 Hit Points, gives 504 Experience and 15 Gold Pieces, and can be fought with Thunder magic or Mega Grenades.

evidence.quote:
JINN
Hit Points: 6,000
Experience Given: 504
Gold Pieces Given: 15...Have the Hero use Thunder magic or just attack with a Mega Grenade.

subject: Volcano
text: The suggested level for Volcano is 20.

subject: Volcano
text: In the Volcano, go right, up, and keep going left to get the White spell.

evidence.quote:
Go right, then up. Go left and keep going until you get the White spell, which
is one of the better ones in the game.

subject: Volcano
text: From the beginning of the Volcano, go left, up, jump to the right, go up the stairs, and go left to get the Mask.

evidence.quote:
Go back to the very beginning of the volcano. Go left, up, and jump to
the right, then go up the stairs. Go left and get the Mask

subject: Lava Dome
text: In the Lava Dome, jump across the tiles in the upper left corner, bomb the rock, go up the stairs, and get the Moon Helm from the treasure chest.

evidence.quote:
Go back there, then go to the upper left corner. Jump
across the tiles, then bomb the rock. Go to the upper left corner and go up the
stairs. Get the Moon Helm from the treasure chest.
